items.title: Orrin Keepnews interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 7, 2002
items.q: how would Woody Herman ever get new players for his band

ctx.x: Absolutely. You know jazz has been elevated, or whatever, I’m not sure of the right word, to a high state of art these days. Do you think it’s been positive for jazz?

That’s a hard question to answer. I do feel that when I have attended the last few jazz educators conventions and I am pleased to see — I used to frown on jazz education because those God damn stage band so-called which were nothing but tired old big band charts and there were important things like the fact that if it wasn’t for North Texas State how would Woody Herman ever get new players for his band, all those cliches of the past. But the fact is I think that to some degree jazz education has done a wonderful…
All right. Good answer. Thank you for your time.
